cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. My tea's stronger than yours. I can handle it without milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same teapot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. First to finish, then. I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fewest refills wins, then. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.

mechanism: A treats a tea preference as a technical tasting competition, correcting B method until A can claim the superior performance.
confusable: Ordinary tea expertise need not seek victory; A must convert each difference or objection into a new comparison A expects to win.
comparison: Dinner alternative controls a judged tasting; tea alternative shifts the metric from flavour to use over time.
seedUse: Milk, same teapot and fast drinking derive from D19-b; S03 adds correction of dilution and tasting pace to A competitive shifts.
